title: Get Audience Overlap Request
x-tool-summary: Read how many people one synced audience shares with others on the same account, as bucketed or approximate ranges.
description: Optional, capability-advertised read of the overlap between one audience the caller synced on an account and up to media_buy.audience_targeting.audience_overlap.max_comparisons other audiences the caller synced on the same account. Returns aggregate counts only, never member identifiers. The caller MUST be authorized to read every compared audience; account membership alone is not enough. Every audience_id MUST be an audience whose members the caller supplied through sync_audiences on this account; seller-owned segments, third-party segments, audiences from another account, and audiences created from an external source cannot be compared. Sellers implementing this task MUST advertise media_buy.audience_targeting.audience_overlap and list media_buy.audience_overlap in experimental_features. Experimental (x-status: experimental): per docs/reference/experimental-status, this surface MAY change between 3.x releases with notice.

account.description: Account that owns every compared audience. Overlap is never computed across accounts.

audience_id.description: The audience to compare from, as the buyer identified it in sync_audiences.

compare_to.description: Audiences to compare against audience_id, as the buyer identified them in sync_audiences. At most media_buy.audience_targeting.audience_overlap.max_comparisons entries; a longer list is rejected with INVALID_REQUEST. MUST NOT contain audience_id or repeat an entry.
